When doravirine is coadministered with rifabutin, the dose of doravirine should be increased to 100 mg orally twice daily (approximately 12 hours apart) for the duration of rifabutin treatment. This adjustment is necessary to maintain therapeutic plasma concentrations of doravirine. 2. In elderly patients, caution should be exercised when administering doravirine due to the increased likelihood of reduced hepatic, renal, or cardiac function, as well as the presence of concomitant diseases or other drug therapies. 3. Amobarbital decreases the plasma levels and effects of doravirine by inducing hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. The coadministration of doravirine with strong CYP3A inducers may lead to reduced doravirine plasma concentrations, loss of virologic response, and potential resistance to doravirine. 4. Doravirine should not be coadministered with atidarsagene autotemcel. Antiretroviral therapy (ART) may interfere with the manufacturing of atidarsagene autotemcel. ARTs should be discontinued for at least one month before cell mobilization or until the expected duration for medication elimination. 36. Doravirine should not be coadministered with betibeglogene autotemcel.
